title: Quarantine Gate: SLO-aware Threshold Tuner for Model Rollouts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a "Quarantine Gate" component that tunes SLO thresholds and automatically isolates traffic cohorts when model rollouts show regression signals. The gate will monitor multi-dimensional SLOs (p50/p95 latency, error rate, token cost per request, and throughput) across canary, A/B, and shadow traffic and apply tunable actions: reduce traffic to variant, downgrade to cheaper quantized variant, increase dedicated capacity, or temporarily quarantine the cohort while alerting ops. The threshold tuner should support adaptive hysteresis, cohort baselining, and cost-aware sensitivity adjustments. Design must prioritize low false-positive rate for production traffic while remaining sensitive enough to catch regressions within the canary window.
acceptance_criteria: Detects >=95% of synthetic regressions injected across latency/error/cost within the configured detection window
False positive rate <=2% when evaluated on the last 90 days of production traces
Configurable via Console UI and Redwood API per project/route with sane defaults
Supports immediate or gradual traffic adjustments and records every automated action to audit logs
Provides metrics and dashboards (Grafana/Console) showing time-to-detection, action taken, and impact on cost/latency
tasks: Write PRD and thresholding algorithm spec (Bayesian detector + hysteresis)
Prototype tuner in isolation with historical trace replay harness
Integrate tuner into rollout controller and routing layer
Add action implementations: traffic-quarantine, model-variant-fallback, capacity-bump API
Build Console controls and API for per-route configuration
Create dashboard panels and alerts for operator override
Run pilot on non-critical customer routes and collect telemetry
Document behavior, runbook, and rollback manual override steps
comments: 2026-02-12 - Aisha: Kickoff meeting held with PM and Reliability. Agreed on multi-signal approach (latency/error/cost/throughput) and need for per-cohort baselines.
2026-02-20 - Miguel: Prototype detector implemented; early results on replay harness look promising for latency anomalies (detects 94/100 injected), cost regressions need tuning.
2026-02-27 - Design feedback from Lin Zhao: prefer Bayesian change-point detector to reduce sensitivity to periodic traffic swings; add min-sample-size guard for low-traffic cohorts.
2026-03-03 - PM review (Sofia Ramirez): Require audit trail for any automated action and an explicit operator override button in Console; also add per-customer opt-out flag for Private deployments.

2026-03-06 - Miguel: Ran pilot synthetic experiment across 15 routes; tuned hysteresis window and cost-tilt parameter; results uploaded to experiment notebook. Preparing PR for rollout controller integration.
decision_log: Choice: Bayesian change-point detector + sliding-window z-score for backup — trade-off favors robustness to diurnal patterns over absolute sensitivity.
Hysteresis: 3 consecutive windows required to trigger action to reduce flapping on noisy routes.
Cost-aware tilt: scale sensitivity down for routes where token-cost oscillations are frequent; confine automatic capacity increases to Dedicated customers only.
Action ordering: prefer traffic shift to stable variant -> quota bump -> quarantine; explicit operator approval required for capacity-sensitive actions in Private deployments.
last_run_results: 2026-03-06 synthetic campaign: 100 injected anomalies (40 latency, 30 error-rate, 30 token-cost). Detector flagged 97 true positives, 1.5% false positive rate, median time-to-action 12s on canary cohorts. Cost-regression sensitivity initially low; adjusted cost-tilt to 1.4x improved detection to 28/30. Full experiment notebook linked.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal testing on staging routes (2 weeks). Phase 1: pilot on 10 low-traffic customer routes with monitoring and manual override (3 weeks). Phase 2: enable automated actions for Dedicated customers only (4 weeks). Phase 3: general availability with per-route opt-in and Console defaults (target runtime-2.3 release).
notes: Need to coordinate with Billing team for token-cost signals; Security to review audit log format. Add flag to disable auto-actions for enterprise customers by default. Consider ML-backed false-positive predictor in follow-up iteration.
